arcades.info_text: Massive tri-level arcade and family entertainment center inside of a gigantic castle located in Nashua, NH, just over the Massachusetts state line. The first floor is mostly redemption games and kid's games, and also features a reasonably priced snack bar. The second floor has modern arcade games alongside classics and rarities from the 90's and 2000's, as well as three rides including a double-decker carousel, Himalaya, and roller coaster. The third floor is currently more sparsely populated but contains a small selection of pinball machines and rhythm games. / All games operate via tokens. Tokens can be purchased with cash at any of the change machines located throughout the building, or with credit cards at the front counter. Each $20 purchased will give you a bonus $5 worth of tokens. The only things that do not operate with tokens are the rides; tickets for these can be purchased at the front counter, excluding the roller coaster which is removed and will be replaced with the Gemstone Mining attraction. / This arcade opens with limited hours from Fridays-Sundays during the school year and Wednesdays-Sundays during school vacations and summer.

arcades.info_text: Shady as hell arcade located inside the equally shady, dying [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=7341#summary]Dover Mall[/url][/b] in Dover, DE. / The arcade appears to be unmanned and unsupervised, and from the looks of things, unmaintained as well. There may have been carpet on the floor here once upon a time but now it's just a bare concrete floor. Many games are out of order or in really bad condition. Games appear to take quarters, but most of the games have their costs scribbled out or scribbled over and it's never entirely clear exactly how much any of these games are supposed to cost. Some games have an out-of-state phone number to contact if you win a prize; calling that number puts you into a voicemail that does not have any further details. Play at your own risk... or better yet, don't play at all and don't give this place or this mall your money. / There is a [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=9229#summary]sister location in Langhorne, PA[/url] at the Oxford Valley Mall near Sesame Place, with similar pricing and lack of care given to the machines.
